descriptions.w3d_d27k_transfer_data_8025b7e8: Handles a data request for the transfer found through 0x8021eab8: mode 1 finishes via 0x8021dd04; mode 0 writes the block through the reader at +76, adds to the total at +32, finishes on a failed write, and sends an acknowledge packet (or finishes when the team flag 64 is clear); mode 2 writes any final block, closes the reader through 0x8020810c and stores state 2.
